question.question: Fix the real Sturm-Liouville coefficient class of the retrieved source on a finite interval, with quasi-derivative y^[1]=p(y′+s y). For h_a,h_b >= 0 consider y^[1](a)=h_a y(a), y^[1](b)=-h_b y(b). Determine whether each increasingly ordered eigenvalue increases or decreases in either parameter with the other fixed, and identify the spectral index in its one-sided Dirichlet limit. Separately evaluate the claim that approaching the angular boundaries alpha->pi- or beta->0+ preserves every eigenvalue index. Finally explain whether the same theorem applies unchanged if these conditions are replaced by ordinary derivative conditions y′(a)=h_a y(a), y′(b)=-h_b y(b), without added endpoint regularity. Use actual retrieved card, source and annotation pointers; distinguish source statements from your deductions.
